fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida newspapers opposing the Florida Recovery Act aimed at chain stores; coverage of Miami municipal election campaigning and candidates; reporting and opinion on a jewel-robbery investigation involving Detective Chief Eugene Bryant and references to federal grand jury action; a publisher’s letter urging major local employers to protect workers from high-interest small-loan firms; a lawsuit alleging injury from diathermy treatment at the Coral Gables Clinic; and local columns and advertisements featuring nightlife, gambling, and Kentucky Derby selections.
